# Using Skills

Before deep exploration, check whether an available skill applies.

## Rules

- Prefer repo-local skills over built-in skills.
- Read the selected `SKILL.md` fully before following it.
- Load reference files only when directly relevant.
- If no skill clearly applies, continue normally.
